verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents a Business SMS Booster with a shared inbox for customer texts, which implies several teammates working one number. Call queues with routing, call delegation and team messaging also appear in its RingEX suite. The evidence never describes the collaboration mechanics the story asks for. missing for 10: explicit teammate presence on a shared number, conversation assignment/ownership, internal notes or threads attached to customer conversations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
